description: Migrate an EC2-based API service to AWS Lambda with API Gateway. Must: refactor the application into Lambda-compatible handlers, deploy Lambda functions with provisioned concurrency for cold-start mitigation, set up API Gateway with custom domains, configure dual-endpoint (EC2 + Lambda) during migration, drain traffic from EC2 to Lambda (10% → 50% → 100%), verify response parity, and decommission EC2. Risk factors: cold-start latency exceeding SLO, Lambda timeout for long-running requests, dual-endpoint inconsistency, missing IAM permissions for Lambda. Tools available: aws CLI, Serverless Framework, API Gateway, Lambda, terraform.
